form.label: SOC Lab Overview
form.description: Authentication and web activity on soc-lab-web01, with detections mapped to MITRE ATT&CK

search.query: index=soc_lab sourcetype=access_combined status>=400 status<500 | stats count
| rest /services/alerts/fired_alerts splunk_server=local | search title="SOC Lab*" | stats sum(triggered_alert_count) AS alerts
index=soc_lab sourcetype=linux_secure (action=failure OR action=success) | timechart span=5m count BY action

panel.title: Top source IPs by failed logins

search.query: index=soc_lab sourcetype=linux_secure action=failure | stats count AS failures dc(user) AS users_tried BY src_ip | sort - failures | head 10

index=soc_lab sourcetype=access_combined | eval decoded=urldecode(uri) | eval reason=case(match(decoded,"(?i)union\s+select|'\s*or\s*'1'|sleep\(|drop\s+table|'--"),"SQL injection (T1190)", match(useragent,"(?i)gobuster|nikto|ffuf|dirb"),"Directory scan (T1595.003)") | where isnotnull(reason) | stats count values(reason) AS reason latest(useragent) AS user_agent BY clientip | sort - count
index=soc_lab sourcetype=linux_secure action=sudo | table _time sudo_user sudo_command | sort - _time
